description: Required fields are enforced by tools/build-topic-review.js. This file documents the editorial contract.
scope: Targeted, non-exhaustive scoping scan. No systematic-review or field-wide absence claim.

temporal.snapshot: A single measurement window or short experiment, without a continuing comparable series.
temporal.repeated: Measurements repeated across dates or releases; units or participants can change.
temporal.longitudinal: The same people, organisations or units followed over time. Duration is reported separately.
temporal.none: Review, conceptual framework or proposed measurement without a new empirical trajectory.

sourceInspection.primary-fulltext: Relevant sections of the primary paper or report were accessible to the AI-assisted review.
sourceInspection.primary-summary: An official author, publisher, dataset or institutional description was inspected.
sourceInspection.primary-abstract: Only the primary abstract was available or inspected.

map: Research facet by temporal design, using only extracted records from this expansion. Themes overlap; cells count sources, not independent datasets, quality, risk or absence of research.
